stem: What is the solution set that best represents the inequality \( y \geq \frac{1}{2}x - 2 \)?
instruction:
Graph the solution set of the linear inequality in the coordinate plane.

• First, select the Graph button to graph the line and choose the line style. To graph a line, select two points in the coordinate plane. A line will connect the points.

• Then select the Solution Set button to select the desired region.
visual_elements: coordinate plane with x and y axes labeled from -4 to 4 on x and -4 to 4 on y, marked with grid lines and pink arrows on axes
Graph interface box with 'Line Type' dropdown showing 'solid' selected
notes: The problem asks to graph the inequality and select the solution region; no answer choices to select except line type and solution set selection buttons.
